result.reason: The redline adds the required Vendor indemnity triggers for third-party IP claims, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breaches, and gross negligence/willful misconduct, while preserving the existing Globix provision. However, it omits the required indemnification procedures governing notice, control of the defense, and cooperation, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. The added language is otherwise targeted, but placing an indemnity provision under “Warranties” without procedural terms is structurally incomplete.
